specified_upstream_compatibility_tests.scope: Four specified regression files with documented fixture compatibility; not the entire upstream suite.

physical_qq_checks.scope: Previously completed physical QQ checks; private screenshots retained locally.

limitations: Requires running, online Windows computer; no 24-hour availability claim.
Message deduplication is at-most-once within its TTL, not exactly-once execution.
Uncertain reminder delivery requires manual review before retry.
Model timeout applies to network operations, not a complete turn.
Source archive excludes runtime environment, credentials, chats and private backups.
